title: Login with email and password
acceptance_criteria:
User Story: Login with email and password

Acceptance Criteria:
- User can log in with a valid email and password
- Email field must be a valid email format
- Password must be at least 8 characters
- After 5 failed attempts, account is locked for 15 minutes
- Successful login redirects to /dashboard
- Failed login shows error message without revealing which field was wrongUser Story: Login with email and password

expected_scenarios.description: Valid email and password logs the user in
Password of exactly 8 characters is accepted (boundary)
Account locks on the 5th failed attempt, not the 4th
Locked account cannot log in even with correct password during the 15 minutes
Error message does not reveal whether email or password was wrong
Injection attempts (SQL injection / XSS) in login fields are handled safely
